question: In ΔPQR, the line drawn from the vertex P intersects QR at a point S. if QR = 4.5 cm and SR = 1.5 cm then the ratios of the area of triangle PQS and triangle PSR is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b6fce6162def129c8baf12822c4b2e2bf75acf9905acf7b478989e25aef6104.png] 

We know that Area = ½ × base × height.

Consider ΔPSR and ΔPQS these two have same height.

The base length of ΔPQS = 4.5 – 1.5 = 3.

So, ratio of their areas is equal to the ratio of their base lengths.

∴ the ratio = 3 : 1.5 = 2 : 1
